ei.title: 5번: The Surprising Origin of the Word Alcohol
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Surprisingly, the English word "alcohol" originally referred to a kind of eyeshadow. In Ancient Egypt, the mineral stibnite was heated to put it through sublimation, the process of turning a solid into a gas. The smoky vapor that was produced left a layer of black powder that could be collected. They used the powder to produce a thick paste, which was then used as eyeshadow. This paste was called kohl, an Arabic term meaning "stain" or "paint." This term was combined with al-, the Arabic word for "the", to create al-kohl, the Arabic word for eyeshadow made from sublimated stibnite. In the mid-1500s, chemists and alchemists discovered this term in ancient textbooks and had a realization that sublimation could draw the purest essence out of something. They began applying this process to liquids produced through a similar process of distillation. Over time, it led to liquors being simply known as "alcohol."

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.tip: 가열(heated) → 결합(combined) → 비슷한(similar) 과정

questions.passage: Surprisingly, the English word "alcohol" originally referred to a kind of eyeshadow. In Ancient Egypt, the mineral stibnite was heated to put it through sublimation, the process of turning a solid into a gas. The smoky vapor that was produced left a layer of black powder that could be collected. They used the powder to produce a thick paste, which was then used as eyeshadow. This paste was called kohl, an Arabic term meaning "stain" or "paint." This term was combined with al-, the Arabic word for "the", to create al-kohl, the Arabic word for eyeshadow made from sublimated stibnite. In the mid-1500s, chemists and alchemists discovered this term in ancient textbooks and had a realization that sublimation could draw the purest essence out of something. They began applying this process to liquids produced through a <u>similar</u> process of distillation. Over time, it led to liquors being simply known as "alcohol."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 similar와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: similar=비슷한 / identical=똑같은 / frequent=잦은 / gentle=부드러운 / different=다른
det.analysis:
① identical(똑같은): similar와 비슷한 뜻이라 반대가 아니에요.
② frequent(잦은): 의미축이 다른 무관한 단어예요.
③ gentle(부드러운): 의미축이 다른 무관한 단어예요.
④ different(다른): similar(비슷한)의 반의어예요 ←정답
det.tip: similar(비슷한)의 반대는 different(다른). identical(똑같은)은 비슷한 뜻의 함정

questions.passage:
(A) By heating the plant for hours, the scientists were able to <u>draw</u> the essential oils out of its leaves. The pure liquid was then stored in small glass bottles.

(B) The little girl liked to <u>draw</u> colorful pictures of her family with crayons. She proudly hung every one of them on the refrigerator door.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 draw의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: draw: (A) 이끌어 내다, 추출하다(동사) (B) 그림을 그리다(동사)
det.analysis:
① (A) 그리다 (B) 이끌어 내다: 의미가 뒤바뀌었어요.
② (A) 이끌어 내다, 추출하다 (B) 그리다: (A)는 잎에서 기름을 '뽑아냈다'는 뜻, (B)는 크레용으로 그림을 '그린다'는 뜻이에요 ←정답
③ (A) 그리다 (B) 그리다: (A)는 기름을 뽑아내는 것이라 '그리다'가 아니에요.
④ (A) 이끌어 내다 (B) 비기다: (B)는 그림을 그리는 것이라 '비기다'가 아니에요.
det.tip: draw의 다의어: 이끌어 내다/추출하다 vs 그림을 그리다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the process of turning a solid directly into a gas without passing through a liquid state"

det.korean: distillation=증류 / collection=수집 / sublimation=승화 / translation=번역
det.analysis:
① distillation(증류): 액체를 끓여 순수하게 만드는 과정이라 정의와 달라요.
② collection(수집): 모으는 것이라 정의와 무관해요.
③ sublimation(승화): 고체가 액체를 거치지 않고 곧바로 기체로 바뀌는 과정이라 정의와 일치해요 ←정답
④ translation(번역): 정의와 무관해요.
det.tip: solid directly into a gas(고체가 곧바로 기체로) → sublimation(승화)

questions.passage: This paste was called kohl, an Arabic term meaning "stain" or "paint." This term was later __________ (combine) with al-, the Arabic word for "the." Together they formed a brand-new word.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: combine(동사원형: 결합하다) → combined(과거분사). 'be동사 + 과거분사'의 수동태
det.analysis: combine(동사원형)을 과거분사 combined로 바꿔요. 앞에 'was(be동사)'가 있고 뒤에 'with al-(~와)'가 있으니 '~와 결합되었다'라는 수동태예요. 수동태는 'be동사 + 과거분사'로 쓰므로 was combined(결합되었다)가 맞아요.
det.tip: was + 과거분사 = 수동태. combine → combined(결합된)

questions.passage: The word al-kohl referred to eyeshadow made from __________ (sublimate) stibnite. Heating the mineral turned it into vapor, which then left the fine black powder behind.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: sublimate(동사원형: 승화시키다) → sublimated(과거분사). 뒤의 명사 stibnite를 꾸미는 과거분사(수동)
det.analysis: sublimate(동사원형)를 과거분사 sublimated로 바꿔요. 뒤의 명사 stibnite(광물)를 앞에서 꾸미는 자리인데, '승화된' 스티브나이트라는 수동의 뜻이 필요해요. 그래서 과거분사 sublimated(승화된)로 써서 'sublimated stibnite(승화된 스티브나이트)'가 맞아요.
det.tip: 명사를 꾸미며 '~된'의 수동 뜻 = 과거분사. sublimate → sublimated(승화된)
